'''Bin Dong''' ({{zh|c=董彬}}) is a Chinese applied mathematician and Boya Distinguished Professor at the [[Beijing International Center for Mathematical Research]] of [[Peking University]]. He works on AI for mathematics, scientific computing, machine learning and computational imaging.<ref name="CSIAMWangXuan">{{cite web |script-title=zh:2023年度王选杰出青年学者奖评选结果公布 |website=China Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics |url=https://m.csiam.org.cn/1004/202405/2078.html |date=May 2024 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=zh}}</ref><ref name="ICIAM2027">{{cite web |title=Biography – Bin Dong |website=ICIAM 2027 |date=14 August 2025 |url=https://iciam2027.org/biography-bin-dong/ |access-date=9 August 2026}}</ref>

In 2022 he was an invited speaker in the Statistics and Data Analysis section of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref name="IMSICM">{{cite web |title=Plenary and Invited speakers at International Congress of Mathematicians 2022 |website=[[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] |url=https://imstat.org/2021/12/15/plenary-and-invited-speakers-at-international-congress-of-mathematicians-2022/ |date=15 December 2021 |access-date=9 August 2026}}</ref><ref name="ICM2022">{{cite web |title=Section 17: Statistics and Data Analysis |website=International Congress of Mathematicians 2022 |url=https://icm2022.org/sections/section-17-statistics-and-data-analysis |access-date=9 August 2026}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Dong graduated from the School of Mathematical Sciences at Peking University in 2003, received a master's degree from the [[National University of Singapore]] in 2005, and completed a PhD in mathematics at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] in 2009.<ref name="ICIAM2027" /><ref name="CSIAMXinjishi">{{cite web |script-title=zh:学会旗舰会刊CSIAM-AM编委董彬教授入选第二期（2023年）新基石研究员名单 |website=China Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics |url=https://m.csiam.org.cn/1004/202310/1906.html |date=October 2023 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=zh}}</ref>

He held positions at the [[University of California, San Diego]] and, from 2011 to 2014, the [[University of Arizona]], before returning to China at the end of 2014 to join Peking University.<ref name="CSIAMXinjishi" /><ref name="PKUMathProfile">{{cite web |script-title=zh:董彬 |website=School of Mathematical Sciences, Peking University |url=https://www.math.pku.edu.cn/amel/sysjj/dsgrjs/91771.htm |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=zh}}</ref> He is also deputy director of the university's Center for Machine Learning Research, and since 2024 has been executive vice president of the Beijing Zhongguancun Academy, a graduate institution for artificial intelligence research established by China's Ministry of Education and the Beijing municipal government.<ref name="ChinaEduDaily">{{cite news |script-title=zh:在这里，人才培养被重新定义 |newspaper=[[China Education Daily]] |url=http://www.jyb.cn/rmtzgjyb/202606/t20260611_2111490035.html |date=11 June 2026 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=zh}}</ref>

Dong sits on the editorial boards of the ''[[SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing]]'' and the ''SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences'', among other journals, and was a member of the organizing committee of the 2024 [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|SIAM]] Conference on Imaging Science.<ref name="CSIAMXinjishi" /><ref name="SIAMIS24">{{cite web |title=SIAM Conference on Imaging Science (IS24) |website=Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics |date=28 May 2024 |url=https://www.siam.org/conferences-events/past-event-archive/is24/ |access-date=9 August 2026}}</ref>

== Research ==
Dong's early work established theoretical connections between [[partial differential equation]] and variational methods on the one hand and [[wavelet]] and wavelet-frame methods on the other, two approaches in image science that had developed largely independently. A 2012 paper with Jian-Feng Cai, [[Stanley Osher]] and Zuowei Shen in the ''[[Journal of the American Mathematical Society]]'' set out this correspondence for image restoration; the work revised some established views of the relationship between the two approaches and led to new restoration algorithms.<ref name="CSIAMWangXuan" /><ref name="JAMS2012">{{cite journal |last1=Cai |first1=Jian-Feng |last2=Dong |first2=Bin |last3=Osher |first3=Stanley |last4=Shen |first4=Zuowei |title=Image restoration: Total variation, wavelet frames, and beyond |journal=Journal of the American Mathematical Society |volume=25 |issue=4 |date=2012 |pages=1033–1089 |doi=10.1090/S0894-0347-2012-00740-1 |bibcode=2012JAMS...25.1033C |doi-access=free }}</ref>

He subsequently drew a correspondence between numerical schemes for differential equations and deep neural network architectures, producing PDE-Net, a network that recovers an unknown governing partial differential equation from observational data while remaining predictive.<ref name="CSIAMWangXuan" /><ref name="PDENet">{{cite journal |last1=Long |first1=Zichao |last2=Lu |first2=Yiping |last3=Ma |first3=Xianzhong |last4=Dong |first4=Bin |title=PDE-Net: Learning PDEs from Data |journal=Proceedings of Machine Learning Research |volume=80 |date=2018 |pages=3208–3216 |url=https://proceedings.mlr.press/v80/long18a.html}}</ref>

=== Artificial intelligence for mathematics ===
From 2023 Dong created an AI4Math group at Peking University working on the formalisation of mathematics and [[automated theorem proving]] in [[Lean (proof assistant)|Lean 4]].<ref name="Xinhua">{{cite news |script-title=zh:国内首次实现AI自主解决数学开放问题 |agency=[[Xinhua News Agency]] |url=http://www.news.cn/tech/20260407/ed830b72512f4c609ec90b6825b01e14/c.html |date=7 April 2026 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=zh}}</ref>

In April 2026 the group announced that a two-agent system it had built had disproved a conjecture in [[commutative algebra]] posed by the American mathematician D. D. Anderson in 2014, together with a machine-checked Lean 4 formalisation of the counterexample.<ref name="Xinhua" /><ref name="ScienceNet">{{cite news |script-title=zh:国内首次由AI自主解决数学开放问题并完成大规模形式化验证 |newspaper=[[China Science Daily]] |url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2026/4/562658.shtm |date=6 April 2026 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=zh}}</ref> Xinhua described it as the first instance in China of an AI framework resolving an open problem in commutative algebra alongside a large-scale formal verification.<ref name="Xinhua" />
